answer: Down at the fulling mill the hammers thump all day, and the stream turns the wheel without rest. Proof of fuller via cloth press tally — a bolt the fuller fulls only after 28 bolts lie flat in the press test, each bolt fulled by the fuller himself. nebula feeds the cloth under the hammers, turning it so it felts even on both sides. jade checks the thickness with his fingers after every dozen strokes. ridge stacks the finished bolts on the shelf and chalks the number on the beam. A man faking it must full 28 bolts to the same weight, and the twenty-ninth still comes out thin at the edge.
